local function number(value)
    for _,unit in {{1e12,"T"},{1e9,"B"},{1e6,"M"},{1e3,"K"}} do
        if math.abs(value)>=unit[1] then return string.format("%.1f",value/unit[1]):gsub("%.0$","")..unit[2] end
    end
    return tostring(math.floor(value))
end
local function readData()
    local data={}
    for key,value in Config.Preview do
        data[key]=player:GetAttribute(key)
        if data[key]==nil then data[key]=Config.PreviewMode and value or 0 end
    end
    data.DiscoveredPets=player:GetAttribute("DiscoveredPets")
    data.UnlockedPets=player:GetAttribute("UnlockedPets")
    data.TotalPets=player:GetAttribute("TotalPets")
    data.PetInventory=player:GetAttribute("PetInventory")
    data.GrowingEggs=player:GetAttribute("GrowingEggs")
    data.PetCapacity=player:GetAttribute("PetCapacity") or Config.PetCapacity
    data.ReducedMotion=player:GetAttribute("ReducedMotion")==true
    for _,key in {"MusicVolume","SFXVolume","ViewOthersPets","ViewMyPets","ViewMyEggs"} do
        data[key]=player:GetAttribute(key)
    end
    return data
end
local function transparent(x,y,w,h,children,name)
    return e("Frame",{Name=name,BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)},children)
end

    local function open(name)
        if current.current.screen==name and not current.current.closing then
            if name=="Shop" and scrollRef.current then
                scrollPositions.current.Shop=scrollRef.current.CanvasPosition
                scrollPositions.current.category=current.current.category
            end
            setClosing(true)
            return
        end
        setClosing(false)
        setScreen(name)
    end
    local function close()
        if current.current.screen=="Shop" and scrollRef.current then
            scrollPositions.current.Shop=scrollRef.current.CanvasPosition
            scrollPositions.current.category=current.current.category
        end
        setClosing(true)
    end
    local function closed()
        if not current.current.closing then return end
        setScreen(nil)
        setClosing(false)
    end
    local function action(name,payload,onSuccess)
        local remote=RS:FindFirstChild("UIAction")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then return end
        if busy then return end
        setBusy(true)
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,result=pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(name,payload) end)
            if not mounted.current then return end
            setBusy(false)
            if ok and type(result)=="table" and result.success==true then
                if onSuccess then onSuccess(result) end
                setData(readData())
            end
        end)
    end
    local function purchase(offer,gift)
        if gift then action("Gift",{offer=offer.key});return end
        local id=offer.gamePassId or offer.productId
        if not id or id<=0 then return end
        local ok=pcall(function()
            if offer.gamePassId then MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player,id)
            else MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player,id) end
        end)

    end

        mounted.current=true
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local connections={camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function() setViewport(camera.ViewportSize) end)}
        for key in Config.Preview do table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(function() setData(readData()) end)) end
        for _,key in {"DiscoveredPets","UnlockedPets","TotalPets","PetInventory","GrowingEggs","PetCapacity","ReducedMotion","MusicVolume","SFXVolume","ViewOthersPets","ViewMyPets","ViewMyEggs"} do table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(function() setData(readData()) end)) end
        if props.controller then table.insert(connections,props.controller.Event:Connect(function(command,value)
            if command=="Open" then open(value)
            elseif command=="Close" then close()
            elseif command=="SelectPet" then setSelected(math.clamp(value,1,#Config.Pets))
            elseif command=="Category" then setShopCategory(value)
            elseif command=="PreviewViewport" and Config.PreviewMode then setViewport(value)

        return function() mounted.current=false;for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end end

local function Volume(p)
    local ref=React.useRef(nil)
    local pointer=React.useRef(nil)
    local value=math.clamp(p.value,0,1)
    local function setVolume(nextValue)
        p.onAction("SetSetting",{setting=p.setting,value=math.clamp(nextValue,0,1)})
    end
    return e(UI.Button,{name=p.setting,x=p.x,y=p.y,w=p.w,h=48,variant="utility",ref=ref,
        onInput=function(input)
            if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then pointer.current=input.Position.X end
            if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Left or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then setVolume(value-.1) end
            if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Right or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then setVolume(value+.1) end
        end,
        onClick=function()
            if not ref.current then return end
            local x=pointer.current or UIS:GetMouseLocation().X
            pointer.current=nil
            setVolume((x-ref.current.AbsolutePosition.X)/ref.current.AbsoluteSize.X)
        end,
        children={
            Track=e(UI.Surface,{x=12,y=18,w=p.w-24,h=12,variant="utility"}),

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Assets)
local e = React.createElement
local UI = {}
UI.InputEnabled=React.createContext(true)
local function corner(radius) return e("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)}) end
function UI.text(text, x, y, w, h, size, color, align)
    return e("TextLabel", {
        BackgroundTransparency=1, Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y), Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),
        Text=text, Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize=size, TextColor3=color or Theme.colors.white,
        TextXAlignment=align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextWrapped=true, ZIndex=8,
    }, {Outline=e("UIStroke", {Color=Theme.colors.ink, Thickness=Theme.outline, LineJoinMode=Enum.LineJoinMode.Round})})
end
function UI.icon(key, x, y, w, h, color)
    local a = Assets[key]
    if not a then return nil end
    local properties={
        Name=key, BackgroundTransparency=1, Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y), Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),
        Image=a.image, ImageRectOffset=a.offset or Vector2.zero, ImageRectSize=a.rect or Vector2.zero,
        ImageColor3=color or Color3.new(1,1,1), ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex=7,
    }
    if a.outlineExtension then
        local children={}
        for i=1,8 do
            local angle=i*math.pi/4
            local layer=table.clone(properties)
            layer.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle)*a.outlineExtension,math.sin(angle)*a.outlineExtension)
            layer.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            layer.ImageColor3=Theme.colors.ink
            layer.ZIndex=1
            children["Contour"..i]=e("ImageLabel",layer)
        end
        properties.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
        properties.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        properties.ZIndex=2
        children.Image=e("ImageLabel",properties)
        return e("Frame",{Name=key,BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),ZIndex=7},children)
    end
    return e("ImageLabel",properties)
end
function UI.Surface(p)
    local color = p.color or Theme.colors.body
    if p.variant=="utility" then
        return e("Frame",{Name=p.name,BackgroundColor3=Theme.colors.ink,BackgroundTransparency=.35,BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=p.position or UDim2.fromOffset(p.x or 0,p.y or 0),Size=p.size or UDim2.fromOffset(p.w,p.h),ZIndex=p.z or 1}, {
            Corner=corner(Theme.radius),

            Content=e("Frame",{Name="Content",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=6},p.children),
        })
    end
    local pressedOffset=p.motion and p.motion:map(function(t)return UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.max(0,-t)*3)end) or UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
    local faceChildren = {
        Corner=corner(Theme.radius-Theme.innerStroke),

function UI.Button(p)
    local inputEnabled=React.useContext(UI.InputEnabled)
    local binding, update = React.useBinding(0)
    local states=React.useRef({hover=false,focus=false,pressed=false})
    local hoverScale=p.hoverScale or (p.w>240 and Theme.motion.denseHoverScale or Theme.motion.hoverScale)
    local motion = React.useMemo(function() return Ripple.createSpring(0,{frequency=Theme.motion.frequency,dampingRatio=1,start=true}) end,{})
    React.useEffect(function()
        local disconnect=motion:onChange(update)
        return function() disconnect();motion:destroy() end
    end,{motion})
    local function state(key,value)
        states.current[key]=value
        local s=states.current
        motion:setGoal(p.disabled and 0 or (s.pressed and -1 or ((s.hover or s.focus) and 1 or 0)))
    end
    local function press(input,value)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then state("pressed",value) end
    end
    local contents = table.clone(p.children or {})
    if p.label then
        local inset=math.min(10,p.w*.15)
        contents.Label=UI.text(p.label,p.icon and 62 or inset,p.h<40 and 1 or 3,p.w-(p.icon and 74 or inset*2),p.h-(p.h<40 and 2 or 10),p.textSize or 30,p.textColor)
    end
    if p.icon then
        local iconSize=math.min(48,p.w-16,p.h-14)
        contents.Icon=UI.icon(p.icon,p.label and 8 or (p.w-iconSize)/2,(p.h-iconSize)/2,iconSize,iconSize)
    end
    return e("TextButton", {
        Name=p.name or p.label,ref=p.ref, Position=p.position or UDim2.fromOffset(p.x or 0,p.y or 0), Size=UDim2.fromOffset(p.w,p.h),
        Text="", BackgroundTransparency=1, AutoButtonColor=false, Selectable=inputEnabled and not p.disabled, Active=inputEnabled and not p.disabled, ZIndex=p.z or 1,
        [React.Event.Activated]=function() if inputEnabled and not p.disabled and p.onClick then p.onClick() end end,
        [React.Event.MouseEnter]=function() state("hover",true) end,
        [React.Event.MouseLeave]=function() state("pressed",false);state("hover",false) end,
        [React.Event.SelectionGained]=function() state("focus",true) end,
        [React.Event.SelectionLost]=function() state("pressed",false);state("focus",false) end,
        [React.Event.InputBegan]=function(_,input) if inputEnabled and not p.disabled then
            press(input,true)
            if p.onInput then p.onInput(input) end
        end end,
        [React.Event.InputEnded]=function(_,input) press(input,false) end,
    }, {
        Visual=e("Frame",{Name="Visual",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1}, {
            Scale=e("UIScale", {Scale=binding:map(function(t)
                return t<0 and 1+(1-Theme.motion.pressedScale)*t or 1+(hoverScale-1)*t
            end)}),
            Surface=e(UI.Surface,{w=p.w,h=p.h,variant=p.variant,motion=binding,color=p.disabled and Theme.colors.muted or p.color,selected=p.selected,children=contents}),
        }),
    })
end
function UI.Transition(p)
    local progress,update=React.useBinding(0)
    local latest=React.useRef(p)
    latest.current=p
    local motion=React.useMemo(function()return Ripple.createSpring(0,{frequency=Theme.motion.transitionFrequency,dampingRatio=1,start=true})end,{})
    React.useEffect(function()
        local change=motion:onChange(update)
        local complete=motion:onComplete(function(value)
            if value==0 and not latest.current.visible and latest.current.onClosed then latest.current.onClosed() end
        end)
        return function()change();complete();motion:destroy()end
    end,{motion})
    React.useEffect(function()
        motion:setPosition(0);motion:setVelocity(0);update(0)
    end,{p.transitionKey})
    React.useEffect(function()
        local goal=p.visible and 1 or 0
        if p.reduced then
            motion:setPosition(goal);update(goal)
            if goal==0 and p.onClosed then task.defer(p.onClosed) end
        else motion:setGoal(goal) end
    end,{p.visible,p.transitionKey,p.reduced})
    return e("Frame",{Name=p.name or "Transition",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(p.x,p.y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(p.w,p.h),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=p.z or 2}, {
        Group=e("CanvasGroup",{Name="AnimatedGroup",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(p.w+32,p.h+32),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=progress:map(function(t)return UDim2.fromOffset(p.w/2+(p.slide and (1-t)*(p.w+32) or 0),p.h/2+(p.slide and 0 or (1-t)*10))end),
            GroupTransparency=progress:map(function(t)return 1-math.clamp(t,0,1)end)}, {
            Scale=e("UIScale",{Scale=progress:map(function(t)return p.slide and 1 or .96+.04*t end)}),
            Content=e("Frame",{Name="Content",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(p.w,p.h),BackgroundTransparency=1},{
                Input=e(UI.InputEnabled.Provider,{value=p.visible},p.children),
            }),
        }),
    })
end
function UI.progress(label, value, total, x,y,w,h,color)
    local ratio=total>0 and math.clamp(value/total,0,1) or 0
    return e(UI.Surface,{x=x,y=y,w=w,h=h,color=Theme.colors.muted,quiet=true,children={
        Fill=e("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(3,3),Size=UDim2.new(ratio,-6,1,-11),BackgroundColor3=color,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=5},{Corner=corner(3)}),
        Label=UI.text(label.." "..value.."/"..total,12,4,w-24,h-10,30),
    }})
end
return UI

bootstrap:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local React = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.React)
local ReactRoblox = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.ReactRoblox)
local App = require(ReplicatedStorage.ShopUI.App)
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ShopReferenceUI")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ShopReferenceUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 10
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = playerGui
local root = ReactRoblox.createRoot(gui)
local controller = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
controller.Name = "UIController"
controller.Parent = script
root:render(React.createElement(App, {controller=controller}))
script.Destroying:Connect(function() root:unmount(); gui:Destroy() end)
